scope: Selected-month dashboard projection only; legacy training, overview, timeline and attendance contracts remain supported.

fields.month: Heading, review/lecture month context, initial resolved-month cache alias
fields.navigation.previous: Previous month action and disabled state
fields.navigation.next: Next month action and disabled state
fields.summary.ksbs[]: KSB badges, preserving sorted unique first four display
fields.topics[]: Monthly topics text; existing unified dashboard currently supplies an empty list
fields.contractStatus: Study-hour loading/unavailable hint and retry action
fields.reviews[].id: Review form fallback identity and booking dialog
fields.reviews[].eventKey: Row identity, review form route and durable booking identity
fields.reviews[].title: Review row and booking dialog title
fields.reviews[].source: Review form destination and booking type
fields.reviews[].date: reviewDate final fallback and booking-event contract
fields.reviews[].scheduledDate: reviewDate first choice and booking dialog
fields.reviews[].scheduledTime: UK time text and booking dialog
fields.assignments[].moduleId: Activity fallback route and row identity
fields.assignments[].activity.title: Assignment title
fields.assignments[].activity.weekTitle: Subtitle and component route week parameter
fields.assignments[].activity.expectedHours: Required hours and completed achieved hours
fields.assignments[].activity.completed: Progress, achieved hours and View/Start action
fields.lectures[].title: Established module/session display title
fields.lectures[].session.id: Row identity and embedded attendance lookup
fields.lectures[].attendance.title: Absence preselection and catch-up notes
fields.lectures[].attendance.recovery.method: Recovery priority and Change/Book catch-up label

removed_from_monthly_wire.proof: Replaced by selected-month lectures, summaries and validated subject/navigation metadata; MonthlyPlanBoard does not consume the programme schedule.
Not read by the Monthly board; retained in legacy/shared schedule paths.
Frontend no longer builds programme-wide Subjects and monthly-log maps for Monthly; server reads authoritative facts and projects display fields.
Monthly uses embedded selected-session absence/catch-up inputs; existing dialogs fetch their own authorized action data. Full attendance endpoint remains available.
Month filtering and title resolution happen server-side; these fields are not read by the selected-month board.

retained_shared_consumers.purpose: Training and Overview continue to use broad tab snapshots.
Legacy and shared TrainingPlanDetails behavior remains available.
Existing timeline, module, overview and legacy monthly consumers retain their contracts.
Full PlanModule, PlanReview and PlanSession definitions are retained for shared consumers.
Legacy tab response remains separate from the compact monthly reader.
Full read_workspace default contract is preserved; monthly projection is opt-in.

intentional_preservation: Unified Subjects currently omit monthlyActivities and ksbCodesByMonth. Empty assignments remain empty; this optimization does not introduce previously hidden activities.
measurement_limits: This map documents code consumers, not live database performance or external-service validation. No learner data is included.
